newer_changes_search: Web search (2026-10-26) after the Cabinet decision of 14 Oct 2026 (PIB 2323264, in the snapshots): NSAP continues 2026-27 to 2030-31; the old age pension continues 'in its existing form' (Rs 200 for 60-79, Rs 500 for 80+). No other change found.

findings.note: Aadhaar, bank account and ration card are now optional, matching §5.2.12. Age proof stays mandatory (§3.1.3 lists acceptable proofs, including a medical certificate).
Card-based field vs §3.1.3 ('should not be left out'); how_to_apply explains it.
